task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer application is open and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible, showing the DICOM viewer interface.

task_completion.description: The DICOM series (Patient GRID001) is loaded into the viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Thumbnails or text in the left-hand explorer panel show the loaded series; a DICOM image is visible in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: The agent interacts with the layout configuration settings or icons.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout selection menu is open, or the mouse cursor is hovering over the grid layout icon in the toolbar.

task_completion.description: The display layout is changed to a tiled grid of at least 2x2.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main viewing area is divided into at least 4 distinct rectangular viewports (tiles).

task_completion.description: At least 4 different slices of the DICOM series are displayed simultaneously in the grid.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Four or more different DICOM images (slices) are visible at once within the tiled viewports.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the grid layout view to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or a terminal command shows the creation of 'grid_layout.png' in the ~/DICOM/exports/ directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to change the layout rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Weasis layout toolbar or menu items.

integrity.description: The screenshot is a genuine capture of the software, not a pre-existing image file opened in a viewer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The image 'grid_layout.png' is shown being exported or saved from within the Weasis interface or via a system screenshot tool while Weasis is active.

integrity.description: The agent is viewing the specific DICOM data provided for the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Patient ID 'GRID001' or the specific synthetic shapes (6 slices) are visible in the viewer.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The DICOM series has PatientID 'GRID001' and contains 6 slices. The final screenshot must be saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/grid_layout.png, must be at least 800x600 pixels in size, and must exceed 10,240 bytes. The layout must be at least 2x2 (4 tiles) showing different slices.
